note: The machine-readable form of the dependency direction in principles.md. tools/verify-dependency-graph.php resolves every file under src/ to a layer through the rules below and fails on any edge this table forbids. A namespace that no rule classifies is itself a failure: an unclassified namespace is one nothing governs.

shared.description: Framework-free types with a stable semantic owner and inward consumers in more than one layer. Depends on nothing.

domain.description: State, invariants and value objects. Depends on nothing but the shared kernel.

application.description: Use cases, authorization, transactions and audit records. Depends inward on the domain.

infrastructure.description: Persistence, rendering, packages, clocks, logs and protocol adapters. Implements application-owned ports.

presentation.description: View models, presenters and form mappers. Shapes application results for a surface without receiving input itself.

delivery.description: HTTP, console, worker and machine-surface entry points. Validates and translates input, formats a result, and owns no business rule.

kernel.description: The single composition root. It is the one place that may see every layer at once, which is what keeps the others from needing to.
